messages.subject: RHadoop on Amazon Elastic Map Reduce (EMR)
parts:
I am trying to install rmr2 on an AWS EMR cluster but it is failing because of missing dependencies "Rcpp", "plyr",.....which are failing to install.
Has any one successfully deployed rmr2 to EMR cluster? If so can you share your experience (or better your deployment scripts)?

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1530] RHadoop on Amazon Elastic Map Reduce (EMR)
parts:
Hi Hesham,
take a look at this, it may be relevant. My old answer was that EMR is not compatible because they have a non standard version of streaming, so even if you solved the dependency problem you'd be left with other issues. But seeing that Jeffrey, who's an early rmr adopter and quite competent at R and Hadoop, has written a bootstrap action for rmr2 on EMR (above link), it may very well be that it's possible to run the combination you have in mind. So my new answer is let's try and see what happens (or let's ask Jeffrey how it tuned out for him: it sounds like he's giving a tutorial based on it).


Antonio
